rows.does_not_recompute: The full historical O1 discovery campaign test by test.
limitations: Compact exact graduation replay, not a reconstruction of every historical exploratory step.
rows.recomputes: The mature-node graduation audit over the frozen 22,885-record carrier and reproduces the declared science digest.

rows.does_not_recompute: The original complete O2 V1.9 historical package or full O2 generation campaign.
limitations: Original complete O2 package is missing; this target is certificate-verification-only.
rows.recomputes: Verification of the recovered O2 V1.9 certificate, parent pins and retained anchor panels.

rows.does_not_recompute: A new broad O3 population census beyond the frozen carrier.
limitations: Graduation replay is exact in the retained frozen scope; it is not a new population-generation campaign.
rows.recomputes: The frozen O3 graduation/classification audit over exact earned carrier evidence.

rows.does_not_recompute: Earlier O4 exploratory work not represented by the Phase-2 reproduction package.
limitations: Exact reproduction is claimed only within the packaged Phase-2 scope.
rows.recomputes: The packaged O4 Phase-2 graduation reproduction script and result.

rows.does_not_recompute: The lost original O5 Phase-2 ZIP or its historical bytes.
limitations: Original and reconstructed science hashes intentionally differ; historical byte identity is not claimed.
rows.recomputes: The O5 Phase-2 graduation classification from sealed parent evidence and rechecks selected parent evidence.

rows.does_not_recompute: Earlier exploratory O6 campaign work outside the packaged Phase-2 reproduction.
limitations: Exact reproduction is claimed only within the packaged Phase-2 scope.
rows.recomputes: The packaged O6 Phase-2 graduation/classification audit and its exact checks.

rows.does_not_recompute: Every historical O7 exploratory subtest as an independently named target.
limitations: This is the canonical graduated O7 authority; test-level registration is a later Recovery-v7 gate.
rows.recomputes: The O7 Phase-2 graduation audit from the frozen graduated O7 material root and reproduces the graduation science digest.
